record.intent: Meet the two refusals a working project runs into — a file the toolchain owns that somebody edited, and a promise left unwritten before a release — and get back to a clean run from each without guessing.

recovery_paths.action: Two honest answers and no third: move the hand-written change into the source it belongs in and build again, or accept losing it and build with --force. The build stops until you pick one, because the two copies cannot both be right.

Ask for the health report first: it says which s0ma packages this machine actually has and what this project is set to, which is what the warning is about. Then name s0ma-core and s0ma-dsl in the project's own list of dependencies.

Write the value the field is waiting for and ask again, or leave the note where it is and stop asking for the release reading until you are ready. A written-down debt is allowed; it earns nothing, and it will not let a release through.

steps.expected_outcome: One line saying how many files were read and that nothing in them was refused.
steps.purpose: Ask whether the project holds together, so that everything after this is measured against a run that was clean.

steps.expected_outcome: The build stops, names the file and the failure, and writes nothing — so the hand-written line is still there to read.
steps.purpose: Build again once a line has been added by hand to a file under build, which is a folder the toolchain writes and owns.

steps.expected_outcome: A clean build, and the file back to what the source says it should be — the hand-written line gone, as asked.
steps.purpose: Say out loud which of the two copies survives: rebuild from the written source and let the hand-written line go.

steps.expected_outcome: The finding that was a warning a moment ago is now the reason the run fails, and the last line names the reading you got.
steps.purpose: Ask the same question at release strictness, once a promise in the source has deliberately been left unwritten.

steps.expected_outcome: The clean line again, this time earned under the reading that refuses a debt.
steps.purpose: Write the promise the field was waiting for and ask once more, at the strictness a release has to pass.

steps.expected_outcome: What is installed, what this project is set to, whether the build is fresh, and one thing to do next.
steps.purpose: When you cannot tell which of these you are in, ask for the health report before changing anything.
